caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object rendered in grayscale on a beige or off-white background. The object consists of a central vertical shaft from which a long, curved arm extends upwards and to the right, ending in a rounded knob. At the bottom of the vertical shaft, there are two short, hooked extensions curving outward in opposite directions. One of the hooks at the bottom points to the left, while the other points to the right. Midway up the shaft, another shorter arm projects horizontally to the left and ends in a smaller, upright hook that curves back toward the shaft. The overall composition is simple and focused, featuring the object centrally positioned with nothing else in the background. The artist's signature, "J. LIPKIN," is lightly inscribed near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Kettle Tilter
